brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: Only 2 pieces placed: piece:0,0,0;full and piece:0,-1,0;full. Need 2 more pieces to reach 4-cell planter; prior 4-cell rhombus was removed.

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell
requirements.evidence: No run parts present. Attempts to create a single continuous run through all 4 cells failed with ROUTE_NO_PATH; routing requires contiguous hex adjacency without diagonal jumps. Two separate runs were possible but do not provide single feed to all cells.

finish.summary: Build has 2 of 4 cells, no water pipe. A 4-cell shape was achievable but continuous pipe routing through all cells was not verified; configurator returned ROUTE_NO_PATH for traversals requiring diagonal adjacency. Honest finish with partial/unmet status.
